map.为什么转换后顺序变了？: Why does the order change after conversion?
map.TOML 要求「表必须位于所有普通键之后」，因此转换器必须先输出根级标量、再逐层: TOML requires that tables come after all plain keys, so a converter must output root-level scalars first and then the table headers level by level, which makes the order look rearranged. This is a constraint of the format, not data loss; to keep a human-readable order, organize the structure hierarchically at the source.

map.递归转换：把当前层级的键分为标量与表两类——值为非数组的对象时归为表，值为「元素: Recursive conversion: split this level's keys into scalars and tables—an object value (not an array) is a table, and a non-empty array whose elements are all objects is a table array; everything else is a scalar. Emit scalars first as key = value, then tables: a table array emits a double-bracket header per element and recurses, while a normal table emits a single-bracket header and recurses. With a prefix, the full key joins the prefix and key with a dot.

Recursive conversion: split keys at the current level into scalars and tables - a non-array object is a table, a non-empty array whose elements are all objects is an array of tables, and everything else is a scalar. Scalars are emitted line by line (key = value), then tables: an array of tables emits a double-bracket header per element and recurses, a plain table emits one bracket header and recurses; with a prefix, the full key joins the prefix and key with a dot. A key is emitted bare only when it matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]+, otherwise it is double-quoted with JSON.stringify, so dots, spaces and empty keys are never misread as nested tables; every segment of a table header is quoted the same way. The indent selector controls the leading whitespace of table headers and scalar lines at each depth (2 spaces / 4 spaces / Tab) and affects layout only, not TOML semantics. TOML has no null type, so null and arrays mixing objects with scalars raise an error instead of being silently rewritten; strings are always double-quoted and escaped, except that strict ISO 8601 date, datetime or time strings are emitted as bare TOML native date/time values (month/day and hour/minute/second ranges are checked first; anything invalid stays an ordinary quoted string).
